description: This PHP class 'HelpController' is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Help plugin module. It handles HTTP requests to provide help-related redirection based on URL validation, employing services for help content management and exception handling for error scenarios.

classes.name: HelpController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling help-related requests and redirecting users accordingly, utilizing the HelpService.

methods.name: getHelpService
methods.description: Retrieves the instance of HelpService, instantiating it if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests, validates URLs via HelpService, and redirects to appropriate help pages or defaults, handling exceptions as needed.
